tagline: Biostatistician — statistical genomics, spatial statistics, and Bayesian & network modeling for biomedical data.
bio: I'm Xiaohang — most people call me David. I trained in biostatistics at Boston University (M.S., 2026), and I work where statistics meets biology: epigenetic aging clocks, knowledge graphs for biomedical questions, spatial genomics, precision oncology. I like models that are honest about uncertainty and answers that survive scrutiny. (Draft bio — David will rewrite this in his own words.)
